newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian police seize huge arms, drugs cache.
newsitem.headline: Colombian police seize huge arms, drugs cache.

text.p: Police seized a huge cache of cocaine and weapons in a raid on a house in a remote area of southwest Colombia on Monday, officials said.

More than 1,100 pounds (500 kg) of cocaine together with 28 rifles, 600 grenades and thousands of rounds of ammunition were confiscated from the building near Puerto Tejada, in Cauca province, a police spokesman said.

Police said the drugs and arms probably belonged to the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC), Latin America's oldest and largest guerrilla army formed as a pro-Soviet force in 1964. No arrests were made.
